researchBasis.label: EIA degree days and weather-sensitive gas demand
EIA Weather Sensitivity in Natural Gas Markets
Extreme weather forecast risk in US natural gas futures
White Reality Check for data snooping

contract.fallback: Unallocated capital remains in US-INDEX-BASKET close-to-close.
contract.signalTiming: Forecast issue-date signals are used only on trading sessions strictly after the issue date.
contract.reversionTiming: Reversion legs use realized gas moves through the weather-follow leg, require the move to match the weather-demand direction, start no earlier than the next trading session, and skip heat-rally fades when lagged storage is below its trailing seasonal norm.
contract.reversionDemandSizing: When selected, cooling-demand-tiered fade sizing uses forecast CDD anomaly versus a 65F base: below 5F trims reversion size, 5-8F modestly adds size, and at least 8F can lift the reversion sleeve up to 0.5x.
contract.heatSignalFreshness: Summer heat-follow exposure is allowed only when no prior broad summer heat signal was issued within the fixed freshness lookback window; repeated heat signals can still qualify for the same-direction fade.
contract.storageDeficitHeatTilt: Fresh summer heat-follow exposure is multiplied by 1.25x, capped at 0.4375x notional, only when lagged EIA Lower 48 storage is below its trailing 5-year seasonal average.
contract.storageTiming: Storage rows are treated as available only after a conservative 7-calendar-day lag from the EIA row date.
contract.selectionPolicy: The architecture requires fresh multi-model heat-follow and storage-aware same-direction overreaction-fade legs. Cool-short rows are kept diagnostic until the data produces enough confirmed cool events. Rank and eligibility use train and validation splits only; holdout metrics are reported after selection.
contract.sourceWeighting: bg-shrink weights are fit only on train-period forecast temperature errors versus NASA POWER actual weighted anomalies, then shrunk halfway toward equal weights.

selected.architectureLabel: Confirmed heat follow plus storage-aware same-direction fade
selected.architectureDescription: Use multi-model forecast consensus to trade summer heat demand first, then fade only gas moves that overextend in the weather-demand direction when storage is not tight.
